ch.68c4203b9f2ed4643489905e: 既然你来了，我们就还有合作的可能。事情是这样的：我找到了透露我们仓库坐标的那些鼠辈们。
ch.68c42053572026c2e2f9f263: 情况是这样。他们打了人之后立刻跑路，丢下了几具燃烧的尸体避人耳目。我们昨天才勉强确定了交换地点。
ch.68c420716419d41fdd34c39c: 有人看见那几个贼眉鼠眼的家伙跑进森林里面去了，所以你大概能在那边找到他们。他们只是些小角色，除了仓库附近的事其他啥都不知道。但该办的事还是得办。
ch.68c4208abe79232b3d61920e: 我想在森林里制造点动静，让所有人都知道，招惹 Skier 就是找死！如果你能找到那两个混账——更好，干掉他们。但你杀谁我其实无所谓。
ch.68c420971546fc49a1c918c4: 明白。那么对我有什么好处？
ch.68c420ae3b8a46d85d97bf65: 你还在尝试去码头，对吧？没有正确的路线，你连海岸线都到不了。我会给你指路。而且我会介绍你认识一个重要人物。这种关系可不是天上掉下来的。
ch.68c420c2aeff63337661a56a: 好吧，我会把森林那边的消息带来的。
ch.68c4212eab4116a9f2e697df: 事情完成了。虽然不知道杀的是不是你说的那几个鼠辈。
ch.68c42144a276634e966231d4: 干得漂亮，兄弟！一个混蛋都爬到我这边来哭着求饶，另一个脑袋挨了一枪。可能就是你干的。
ch.68c421c0a694a422b7932699: 那个来求你的家伙后来怎样了？
ch.68c421de1df280266f74af12: 他都投降了。为什么要杀他？
ch.68c421ec1d2d6a33a77c645a: 兄弟，你现在怎么变哲学家了？在塔科夫，你搞砸一次就完蛋了。记住这一点，别在鸡毛蒜皮的事上犯错。
ch.68c421f6256605261d57d3e7: 不错。你可不能相信这种鼠辈。
ch.68c422015ff2e3e576ff38de: 哈哈，看来你懂了！到了我这层级，哪还有怜悯的余地，尤其对他们这种小喽啰。最好别试探我的信任。
ch.68c422ad2181f43516a73794: 你之前说会帮我搭上线，带我去海岸线。
ch.68c422cc05274c9ad5171b8d: 当然没错！我的手下会把你带到那的，而且——听清楚了，也只有我能给你搞来 Peacekeeper 的联系方式，现在知道哥厉害了吧？哈哈！
ch.68c422da70c5f51811709b3f: 他真的是联合国的人吗？还是别的什么国际机构？
ch.68c422e5d1933af49d69ed63: 差不多吧。那家伙满嘴都是和平和秩序什么的，但私底下为了自己的利益四处贩卖西方装备。别太信他。
ch.68c422f78a62e38b4a799647: 他会和 PMC 合作吗？
ch.68c4230731915b86d52f9e69: 是的，但要看你怎么理解了。那家伙现在只是跟你做生意而已，要到之后才会有更多往来。你乖乖替我干活，说不定我能替你争取点机会来。

cz.68c4203b9f2ed4643489905e: Když už jsi tady, je pořád šance, že budeme spolupracovat. Tady máš, co se stalo: našel jsem krysy, co vynesly souřadnice našeho skladu.
cz.68c42053572026c2e2f9f263: V tom je právě ten háček. Zdrhli hned po útoku a nechali tam pár hořících mrtvol jako návnadu. Došlo nám to až včera.
cz.68c420716419d41fdd34c39c: Ty zkurvysyny viděli, jak míří do Woods, takže je najdeš tam. Jsou to jenom malý ryby, nevěděli víc než o tom skladu. Ale i tak jim to nemůžu nechat projít.
cz.68c4208abe79232b3d61920e: Udělej v tom lese trochu humbuk a někoho sundej. Chci, aby všichni věděli, že nasrat Skierovi se rovná rozsudku smrti! Jestli najdeš ty dvě krysy zkurvený – dobře, znič je. Ale je mi vcelku jedno, koho zabiješ.
cz.68c420971546fc49a1c918c4: Rozumím. A co z toho budu mít já?
cz.68c420ae3b8a46d85d97bf65: Pořád se snažíš dostat do přístavu, že jo? Bez správných cest se nedostaneš ani na Shoreline. Ukážu ti cestu. Navíc tě seznámím s někým důležitým. Takovýhle kontakty nerostou na stromech.
cz.68c420c2aeff63337661a56a: Dobře, platí. Přinesu zprávy z Woods.
cz.68c4212eab4116a9f2e697df: Práce hotová. Nejsem si jistej, jestli to byly zrovna ty tvoje krysy.
cz.68c42144a276634e966231d4: Kurva dobrá práce! Jeden z těch debilů ke mně sám doplazil a prosil o odpuštění, ten druhej schytal kulku. Možná tvoje práce.
cz.68c421c0a694a422b7932699: A co se stalo s tím, co přišel k tobě?
cz.68c421de1df280266f74af12: Přišel se vzdát. Proč jsi ho takhle zabil?
cz.68c421ec1d2d6a33a77c645a: Co, ty jsi nějakej morální filozof teď? V Tarkovu to posereš jednou a je konec. Pamatuj si to a neser se s maličkostma.
cz.68c421f6256605261d57d3e7: Dobrá úvaha. Krysy jako on se nedají věřit.
cz.68c422015ff2e3e576ff38de: Opa, vypadá to, že ti to dochází! Na mojí úrovni není čas na slitování, zvlášť pro takovýhle malý ryby. Radši netestuj moji důvěru.
cz.68c422ad2181f43516a73794: Říkal jsi, že mě spojíš s nějakým velkým hráčem a ukážeš mi cestu na Shoreline.
cz.68c422cc05274c9ad5171b8d: Přesně tak. Moji hoši tě tam dovedou, zatímco já, a jenom já, ti můžu sehnat kontakt na Peacekeepera, hehe!
cz.68c422da70c5f51811709b3f: Je napojenej na OSN, nebo co?
cz.68c422e5d1933af49d69ed63: Jo, jako všichni! Mluví o míru a pořádku, ale pod stolem prodává evropský vybavení a kryje si vlastní zájmy. Nezabydluj se kolem něj moc.
cz.68c4230731915b86d52f9e69: Jo, ale nebude se s kdekým brodit bahnem. Prozatím s tebou bude jen obchodovat, nic víc. Možná později, přes mě, uzavřeš pořádnej obchod.

en.68c4203b9f2ed4643489905e: Since you’re here, there’s still hope for us to work together. Here’s the score: I found the rats who leaked our warehouse coordinates.
en.68c42053572026c2e2f9f263: That’s the catch. They legged it right after the hit and left a couple of burning corpses as decoys. We only twigged the swap yesterday.
en.68c4205ec704a7df462afe74: Any idea where they are now?
en.68c420716419d41fdd34c39c: Those fucks were spotted heading into the Woods, so that’s where you’ll find them. They’re just small-time runners, didn’t know much past the warehouse. But still, can’t let that shit slide.
en.68c42079129f4fda771a90f2: What do you want me to do?
en.68c4208abe79232b3d61920e: To make some noise in that forest and drop someone. I want everyone to know that crossing Skier is a death wish! If you find those two rat cunts — good, fuck them up. But I don’t really care who you kill.
en.68c420971546fc49a1c918c4: Got it. And what’s in it for me?
en.68c420ae3b8a46d85d97bf65: You’re still trying to reach the port, right? Without the right paths you won’t even make it to Shoreline. I’ll point you the way. Plus, I’ll introduce you to someone important. Connections like that don’t grow on trees.
en.68c420c2aeff63337661a56a: Alright, deal. I’ll bring news from the Woods.
en.68c4212eab4116a9f2e697df: Job’s done. Not sure if they were your rats, though.
en.68c42144a276634e966231d4: Proper good fucking job! One of those muppets crawled to me himself begging for forgiveness, the other one caught a bullet. Might’ve been your handiwork.
en.68c421c0a694a422b7932699: And what happened to the one who came to you?
en.68c421cf573334253d7e141f: I put him down, of course!
en.68c421de1df280266f74af12: He came to surrender. Why kill him like that?
en.68c421ec1d2d6a33a77c645a: What, you some kind of moral philosopher now? In Tarkov, you screw up once, and that’s it. Remember that, and don’t mess up over small stuff.
en.68c421f6256605261d57d3e7: Good call. You can’t trust rats like him.
en.68c422015ff2e3e576ff38de: Opa, looks like you get it! At my level there’s no time for mercy, especially for small fry like them. Best not to test my trust.
en.68c422ad2181f43516a73794: You said you’d hook me up with some big shot and show me the way to Shoreline.
en.68c422cc05274c9ad5171b8d: That’s right. My lads will guide you there, while I, and only I, can get you Peacekeeper’s contact, hehe!
en.68c422da70c5f51811709b3f: Is he tied to the UN or something?
en.68c422e5d1933af49d69ed63: Yeah, like all of them! Talks peace and order, but he’s flogging European kit under the table, covering his own interests. Don’t get too comfy around him.
en.68c4230731915b86d52f9e69: He does, but he won’t wade through muck with just anyone. For now he’ll only do trades with you, nothing else. Maybe later, through me, you’ll strike a proper deal.

fr.68c4203b9f2ed4643489905e: Puisque tu es là, il y a encore une chance qu’on travaille ensemble. Voilà le topo : j’ai retrouvé les rats qui ont fait fuiter les coordonnées de notre entrepôt.
fr.68c42053572026c2e2f9f263: C’est là que ça se complique. Ils ont détalé juste après le coup et ont laissé quelques cadavres en feu comme leurres. On n’a compris l’échange qu’hier.
fr.68c4205ec704a7df462afe74: Vous avez une idée d’où ils sont maintenant ?
fr.68c420716419d41fdd34c39c: Ces enfoirés ont été aperçus en route vers les bois, c’est là que tu  les trouveras. C’étaient juste des petits coursiers, ils ne savaient pas grand-chose au-delà de l’entrepôt. Mais on ne peut pas laisser passer ça.
fr.68c42079129f4fda771a90f2: Qu’est-ce que vous voulez que je fasse ?
fr.68c4208abe79232b3d61920e: Foutre le bordel dans cette forêt et descendre quelqu’un. Je veux que tout le monde sache que croiser Skier, c’est signer son arrêt de mort ! Si tu tombes sur ces deux rats de merde, tant mieux, défonce-les. Mais franchement, je m’en fous de qui tu tues.
fr.68c420971546fc49a1c918c4: Compris. Et qu’est-ce que j’y gagne ?
fr.68c420ae3b8a46d85d97bf65: Tu  cherches toujours à atteindre le port, non ? Sans les bons itinéraires, tu n’arriveras même pas jusqu’au littoral. Je te montrerai le chemin. Et en plus, je te présenterai quelqu’un d’important. Des contacts comme ça, ça ne pousse pas sur les arbres.
fr.68c420c2aeff63337661a56a: D’accord, marché conclu. Je vous ramènerai des nouvelles des bois.
fr.68c4212eab4116a9f2e697df: Travail terminé. Pas sûr que c’étaient vos rats, cependant.
fr.68c42144a276634e966231d4: Putain de bon boulot ! L’un de ces abrutis est venu ramper jusqu’à moi pour demander pardon, l’autre a pris une balle. C’était peut-être ton œuvre.
fr.68c421c0a694a422b7932699: Et qu’est-il arrivé à celui qui est venu vous voir ?
fr.68c421de1df280266f74af12: Il venait se rendre. Pourquoi l’avoir tué comme ça ?
fr.68c421ec1d2d6a33a77c645a: Quoi, tu es devenu philosophe moral ? À Tarkov, tu merdes une fois, et c’est fini. Garde-le en tête, et ne fais pas d’erreur pour des broutilles.
fr.68c421f6256605261d57d3e7: Bon choix. On ne peut pas faire confiance à des rats comme lui.
fr.68c422015ff2e3e576ff38de: Opa ! On dirait que tu as compris. À mon niveau, il n’y a pas de place pour la pitié, surtout pour des petites frappes comme eux. Mieux vaut ne pas mettre ma confiance à l’épreuve.
fr.68c422ad2181f43516a73794: Vous aviez dit que vous me mettriez en relation avec un gros bonnet et que vous me montreriez le chemin vers le littoral.
fr.68c422cc05274c9ad5171b8d: Exactement. Mes gars te guideront jusque-là, et moi, et moi seul, je peux te fournir le contact de Peacekeeper, héhé !
fr.68c422da70c5f51811709b3f: Il est lié à l’ONU ou quelque chose comme ça ?
fr.68c422e5d1933af49d69ed63: Ouais, comme tous ces types-là ! Ils parlent de paix et d’ordre, mais ils refourguent du matériel européen sous la table, pour servir leurs propres intérêts. Ne te sens pas trop à l’aise avec lui.
fr.68c4230731915b86d52f9e69: Oui, mais il ne va pas patauger dans la boue avec n’importe qui. Pour l’instant, il acceptera seulement de commercer avec toi, rien de plus. Peut-être que plus tard, par mon intermédiaire, tu conclureras un vrai marché.

it.68c4203b9f2ed4643489905e: Visto che sei qui, c'è ancora speranza che possiamo lavorare insieme. Ecco come stanno le cose: ho trovato i traditori che hanno rivelato le coordinate del nostro magazzino.
it.68c42053572026c2e2f9f263: Questo è il trucco. Sono scappati subito dopo il colpo e hanno lasciato un paio di cadaveri in fiamme come esche. Abbiamo capito lo scambio solo ieri.
it.68c4205ec704a7df462afe74: Hai idea di dove siano adesso?
it.68c420716419d41fdd34c39c: Quei bastardi sono stati avvistati mentre si dirigevano verso i boschi, quindi è lì che li troverai. Sono solo piccoli corrieri, non sapevano molto oltre il magazzino. Ma comunque, non possiamo lasciar correre.
it.68c4208abe79232b3d61920e: Per fare un po' di rumore in quella foresta e far fuori qualcuno. Voglio che tutti sappiano che attraversare Skier è un desiderio di morte! Se trovi quei due stronzi, bene, fottili. Ma non mi interessa chi uccidi.
it.68c420971546fc49a1c918c4: Capito. E io cosa ci guadagno?
it.68c420ae3b8a46d85d97bf65: Stai ancora cercando di raggiungere il porto, vero? Senza i percorsi giusti non riuscirai nemmeno ad arrivare a Shoreline. Ti indicherò la strada. Inoltre, ti presenterò una persona importante. Connessioni come queste non si trovano facilmente.
it.68c420c2aeff63337661a56a: Va bene, affare fatto. Ti terrò aggiornato su ciò che succede nei Boschi.
it.68c4212eab4116a9f2e697df: Lavoro fatto. Non sono sicuro che fossero i tuoi topi, però.
it.68c42144a276634e966231d4: Ottimo lavoro, cazzo! Uno di quei burattini è venuto strisciando da me implorando perdono, l'altro si è beccato una pallottola. Potrebbe essere opera tua.
it.68c421c0a694a422b7932699: E cosa è successo a colui che è venuto da te?
it.68c421de1df280266f74af12: È venuto per arrendersi. Perché ucciderlo in quel modo?
it.68c421ec1d2d6a33a77c645a: Cosa, sei diventato una specie di filosofo morale adesso? A Tarkov, se sbagli una volta, è finita. Ricordalo e non rovinare tutto per delle sciocchezze.
it.68c421f6256605261d57d3e7: Ottima osservazione. Non ci si può fidare di topi come lui.
it.68c422015ff2e3e576ff38de: Opa, sembra che tu abbia capito! Al mio livello non c'è tempo per la pietà, specialmente per i pesci piccoli come loro. Meglio non mettere alla prova la mia fiducia.
it.68c422ad2181f43516a73794: Hai detto che mi avresti messo in contatto con un pezzo grosso e mi avresti mostrato la strada per Shoreline.
it.68c422cc05274c9ad5171b8d: Esatto. I miei ragazzi ti accompagneranno lì, mentre io, e solo io, posso procurarti il contatto di Peacekeeper, hehe!
it.68c422da70c5f51811709b3f: È legato all'ONU o qualcosa del genere?
it.68c422e5d1933af49d69ed63: Sì, come tutti loro! Parla di pace e ordine, ma sottobanco vende kit europei, perseguendo i propri interessi. Non fidarti troppo di lui.
it.68c4230731915b86d52f9e69: Lo fa, ma non è disposto a sporcarsi le mani con chiunque. Per ora farà affari solo con te, nient'altro. Forse più avanti, tramite me, potrai concludere un accordo adeguato.

jp.68c4203b9f2ed4643489905e: てめえがここに居るというのなら、一緒に仕事ができそうだな。結論だが、倉庫の位置をリークしやがったネズミたちを見つけた。
jp.68c4204bb76107f08988d17c: そいつらは始末したのか？
jp.68c42053572026c2e2f9f263: そこが問題だ。ヤツらは襲った直後に逃げやがって、囮に燃えた死体をいくつか残していきやがった。俺達は昨日ようやくすり替えに気がついたんだ。
jp.68c420716419d41fdd34c39c: 森に向かっているところを目撃したらしい、ヤツらはそこにいるらしい。ちょっとした逃亡者だ、倉庫の向こうのことはよく知りはしない。だがこのクソ野郎は見過ごせねえな。
jp.68c42079129f4fda771a90f2: 俺は何をしたらいいんだ？
jp.68c4208abe79232b3d61920e: 森で騒ぎを起こして、誰かを殺るんだ。Skier に逆らうということは死にたいってことだと知らしめてやれ。あのネズミども二人を見つけたら、いいぜ、ぶっ殺してやれ。だがまあ誰を殺そうと構わねえぜ。
jp.68c420971546fc49a1c918c4: 分かった、それで見返りは？
jp.68c420ae3b8a46d85d97bf65: まだ港に行こうとしてるんだろう？正しい道を知らなけりゃ Shoreline にすらたどり着けねえ。道を教えてやる。それと、重要人物を紹介してやるよ。そんなコネはそう簡単には見つからねえぞ。
jp.68c420c2aeff63337661a56a: 分かった、それでいこう。Woods からニュースを持ち帰ってくるぞ。
jp.68c4212eab4116a9f2e697df: 仕事は終わった。だがそいつらがあんたのネズミどもかどうかは分からないが。
jp.68c42144a276634e966231d4: 本当によくやってくれた！あの愚かなヤツらの一人は自分で俺の所に這いつくばって許してくれと言いに来て、もう一人は銃弾に倒れたぜ。てめえの仕業かもな。
jp.68c421c0a694a422b7932699: それであんたのところに来たやつはどうなったんだ？
jp.68c421de1df280266f74af12: 降参しに来たんだろう？どうしてそんな風に殺したんだ？
jp.68c421ec1d2d6a33a77c645a: なんだ、今更道徳者哲学者気取りか？タルコフでは一度ミスすればそれで終わりだ。覚えておけ、些細なことで失敗するなよ。
jp.68c421f6256605261d57d3e7: 良い判断だ、そういうネズミは信用出来ない。
jp.68c422015ff2e3e576ff38de: おお、分かってんじゃねえか！俺の基準じゃ情けはかけねえ。特にヤツらのような雑魚にはな。俺に信頼を試すんじゃねえぞ。
jp.68c422ad2181f43516a73794: 大物を紹介して Shoreline まで案内してくれるって話だったな。
jp.68c422cc05274c9ad5171b8d: そうだな。俺の仲間が案内してくれる。Peacekeeper の連絡先は俺しか手に入れらんねえからな、へへ！
jp.68c422da70c5f51811709b3f: 国連となにか繋がりが？
jp.68c422e5d1933af49d69ed63: ああ、皆そうだぜ！口では平和だ秩序だの謳ってやがるが、裏ではヨーロッパの装備を売りつけて己の利益を隠してやがる。あまり親しくなりすぎないほうがいいぜ。
jp.68c422f78a62e38b4a799647: PMC と協力関係があるのか？
jp.68c4230731915b86d52f9e69: そうだぜ、だがそいつは誰とでも泥沼にはまり込むようなことはしねえ。今のところはてめえとは取引だけだ。それ以外は何もねえ。もしかすると、また後で俺を通じてちゃんとした取引ができるかもな。

kr.68c4203b9f2ed4643489905e: Since you’re here, there’s still hope for us to work together. Here’s the score: I found the rats who leaked our warehouse coordinates.
kr.68c42053572026c2e2f9f263: That’s the catch. They legged it right after the hit and left a couple of burning corpses as decoys. We only twigged the swap yesterday.
kr.68c4205ec704a7df462afe74: Any idea where they are now?
kr.68c420716419d41fdd34c39c: Those fucks were spotted heading into the Woods, so that’s where you’ll find them. They’re just small-time runners, didn’t know much past the warehouse. But still, can’t let that shit slide.
kr.68c42079129f4fda771a90f2: What do you want me to do?
kr.68c4208abe79232b3d61920e: To make some noise in that forest and drop someone. I want everyone to know that crossing Skier is a death wish! If you find those two rat cunts — good, fuck them up. But I don’t really care who you kill.
kr.68c420971546fc49a1c918c4: Got it. And what’s in it for me?
kr.68c420ae3b8a46d85d97bf65: You’re still trying to reach the port, right? Without the right paths you won’t even make it to Shoreline. I’ll point you the way. Plus, I’ll introduce you to someone important. Connections like that don’t grow on trees.
kr.68c420c2aeff63337661a56a: Alright, deal. I’ll bring news from the Woods.
kr.68c4212eab4116a9f2e697df: Job’s done. Not sure if they were your rats, though.
kr.68c42144a276634e966231d4: Proper good fucking job! One of those muppets crawled to me himself begging for forgiveness, the other one caught a bullet. Might’ve been your handiwork.
kr.68c421c0a694a422b7932699: And what happened to the one who came to you?
kr.68c421cf573334253d7e141f: I put him down, of course!
kr.68c421de1df280266f74af12: He came to surrender. Why kill him like that?
kr.68c421ec1d2d6a33a77c645a: What, you some kind of moral philosopher now? In Tarkov, you screw up once, and that’s it. Remember that, and don’t mess up over small stuff.
kr.68c421f6256605261d57d3e7: Good call. You can’t trust rats like him.
kr.68c422015ff2e3e576ff38de: Opa, looks like you get it! At my level there’s no time for mercy, especially for small fry like them. Best not to test my trust.
kr.68c422ad2181f43516a73794: You said you’d hook me up with some big shot and show me the way to Shoreline.
kr.68c422cc05274c9ad5171b8d: That’s right. My lads will guide you there, while I, and only I, can get you Peacekeeper’s contact, hehe!
kr.68c422da70c5f51811709b3f: Is he tied to the UN or something?
kr.68c422e5d1933af49d69ed63: Yeah, like all of them! Talks peace and order, but he’s flogging European kit under the table, covering his own interests. Don’t get too comfy around him.
kr.68c4230731915b86d52f9e69: He does, but he won’t wade through muck with just anyone. For now he’ll only do trades with you, nothing else. Maybe later, through me, you’ll strike a proper deal.

po.68c4203b9f2ed4643489905e: Já que você apareceu, ainda tem esperança de a gente trabalhar junto. Vou te pôr a par: encontrei os ratos que vazaram as coordenadas do nosso depósito.
po.68c42053572026c2e2f9f263: É aí que tá o problema. Eles meteram o pé logo depois do golpe e deixaram uns cadáveres queimando como isca. A gente só percebeu a troca ontem.
po.68c4205ec704a7df462afe74: Tem alguma ideia de onde eles estão agora?
po.68c420716419d41fdd34c39c: Esses filhos da puta foram avistados indo pras Woods, então é lá que você vai encontrá-los. São um bando de mulas, não sabiam muita coisa além do depósito. Mas mesmo assim, não dá pra deixar essa merda passar.
po.68c42079129f4fda771a90f2: O que você quer que eu faça?
po.68c4208abe79232b3d61920e: Fazer um barulhão nessa floresta e derrubar alguém. Quero que todo mundo saiba que trair o Skier é sentença de morte! Se encontrar esses dois ratos malditos — ótimo, faz eles pagarem. Mas não tô muito preocupado com quem você matar.
po.68c420971546fc49a1c918c4: Entendido. E o que tem pra mim?
po.68c420ae3b8a46d85d97bf65: Você ainda tá tentando chegar no porto, né? Sem as rotas certas, você nem chega perto de Shoreline. Eu te aponto o caminho. Mais do que isso: vou te apresentar a alguém importante. Conexões assim não aparecem do nada.
po.68c420c2aeff63337661a56a: Tá bom, fechado. Vou trazer notícias das Woods.
po.68c4212eab4116a9f2e697df: Serviço feito. Não sei se eram seus ratos, mas tá feito.
po.68c42144a276634e966231d4: Trabalho bem-feito, porra! Um desses idiotas veio rastejando até mim implorando perdão, o outro levou uma bala. Pode ter sido obra sua.
po.68c421c0a694a422b7932699: E o que aconteceu com o que veio até você?
po.68c421cf573334253d7e141f: Eu acabei com ele, é claro!
po.68c421de1df280266f74af12: Ele veio se entregar. Por que matar assim?
po.68c421ec1d2d6a33a77c645a: O quê, você virou filósofo agora? Em Tarkov, você vacila uma vez e acabou. Lembra disso, e não vacila nas coisas pequenas.
po.68c421f6256605261d57d3e7: Boa decisão. Não dá pra confiar em rato como ele.
po.68c422015ff2e3e576ff38de: Opa, parece que você entendeu! No meu nível não tem tempo pra misericórdia, especialmente com peixinhos como eles. Melhor não testar minha confiança.
po.68c422ad2181f43516a73794: Você disse que ia me apresentar a um figurão e me mostrar o caminho pra Shoreline.
po.68c422cc05274c9ad5171b8d: Exato. Meus caras vão te guiar até lá, enquanto eu, e só eu, posso conseguir o contato do Peacekeeper, hehe!
po.68c422da70c5f51811709b3f: Ele é ligado à ONU ou coisa assim?
po.68c422e5d1933af49d69ed63: É, como todos eles! Fala de paz e ordem, mas vende equipamento europeu por baixo do pano, protegendo os próprios interesses. Não fique muito à vontade com ele.
po.68c4230731915b86d52f9e69: Trabalha, mas não se mete em sujeira com qualquer um. Por enquanto ele só vai fazer trocas com você, nada mais. Talvez mais pra frente, por mim, vocês fechem um acordo de verdade.

es.68c4203b9f2ed4643489905e: Ya que estás aquí, aún hay esperanzas de que trabajemos juntos. Esta es la situación: encontré a las ratas que filtraron las coordenadas de nuestro almacén.
es.68c42053572026c2e2f9f263: Ahí está el detalle. Se largaron justo después del robo y dejaron un par de cadáveres quemados como distracción. No nos dimos cuenta del cambio hasta ayer.
es.68c4205ec704a7df462afe74: ¿Tienes alguna idea de dónde están ahora?
es.68c420716419d41fdd34c39c: Vieron a esos capullos entrando a Woods, así que ahí es donde los encontrarás. No son más que unos chivatos de poca monta; no sabían mucho más allá del almacén. Pero aun así, no podemos dejar pasar esta mierda.
es.68c4208abe79232b3d61920e: Que armes un poco de jaleo en ese bosque y te cargues a algunos. ¡Quiero que todo el mundo sepa que meterse con Skier es una sentencia de muerte! Si encuentras a esas dos putas ratas, bien, reviéntales la puta cabeza. Pero la verdad es que me da igual a quién mates.
es.68c420971546fc49a1c918c4: Lo entiendo. ¿Y qué gano yo haciendo eso?
es.68c420ae3b8a46d85d97bf65: ¿Sigues intentando llegar al puerto, cierto? Sin los caminos adecuados, ni siquiera llegarás a Shoreline. Te indicaré el camino. Además, te presentaré a alguien importante. Contactos como ese no se encuentran todos los días.
es.68c420c2aeff63337661a56a: Vale, trato hecho. Espera noticias de Woods.
es.68c4212eab4116a9f2e697df: El trabajo está hecho. Aunque no estoy seguro de que hayan sido las ratas que buscabas.
es.68c42144a276634e966231d4: ¡Has hecho un trabajo cojonudo! Uno de esos mamones ha regresado arrastrándose a pedirme perdón; al otro le han pegado un tiro. Puede que tú hayas tenido algo que ver con eso último.
es.68c421c0a694a422b7932699: ¿Y qué pasó con el que vino a verte?
es.68c421de1df280266f74af12: Vino a entregarse. ¿Por qué matarlo sin más?
es.68c421ec1d2d6a33a77c645a: ¿Qué, ahora eres una especie de filósofo moral? En Tarkov, si la cagas una sola vez, se acabó. Recuérdalo y no vayas a cagarla por cosas sin importancia.
es.68c421f6256605261d57d3e7: Buena decisión. No se puede confiar en ratas como él.
es.68c422015ff2e3e576ff38de: ¡Opa, parece que lo has pillado! A mi nivel no hay tiempo para la misericordia, especialmente para los don nadie como ellos. Es mejor que no pongan a prueba mi confianza.
es.68c422ad2181f43516a73794: Dijiste que me presentarías con alguien importante y me mostrarías el camino a Shoreline.
es.68c422cc05274c9ad5171b8d: Así es. Mis chicos te guiarán hasta allí, mientras que yo, y solo yo, puedo conseguirte el contacto de Peacekeeper, ¡je-je!
es.68c422da70c5f51811709b3f: ¿Tiene alguna relación con la ONU o algo así?
es.68c422e5d1933af49d69ed63: ¡Sí, como todos ellos! Habla de paz y orden, pero está vendiendo equipamiento europeo bajo la mesa, velando por sus propios intereses. No te fíes demasiado de él.
es.68c4230731915b86d52f9e69: Sí, pero no se mete en líos con nadie. Por ahora, solo comerciará contigo, nada más. Quizá más adelante, a través de mí, puedas llegar a un buen acuerdo con él.

tu.68c4203b9f2ed4643489905e: Madem geldin, birlikte çalışma şansımız hâlâ var. Durum şu: Depo koordinatlarımızı sızdıran fareleri buldum.
tu.68c42053572026c2e2f9f263: İşin püf noktası şu. Baskından hemen sonra tüydüler ve yem olarak birkaç yanmış ceset bıraktılar. Bu değiş tokuşu ancak dün fark ettik.
tu.68c4205ec704a7df462afe74: Şu an nerede olduklarına dair bir fikrin var mı?
tu.68c420716419d41fdd34c39c: O itler Woods’a doğru giderken görülmüş, yani onları orada bulacaksın. Ufak tefek koşucu tipler, depo dışında pek bir şey bilmiyorlardı. Ama yine de, böyle bir şeyi sineye çekemem.
tu.68c4208abe79232b3d61920e: Ormanda biraz gürültü koparıp birini indirmeni istiyorum. Herkes Skier’ı karşına almanın ölüm dileği olduğunu bilsin! O iki fare götünü bulursan — güzel, gebert onları. Ama kimi öldürdüğün umurumda değil.
tu.68c420ae3b8a46d85d97bf65: Hâlâ limana ulaşmaya çalışıyorsun, değil mi? Doğru patikalar olmadan Shoreline’a bile varamazsın. Sana yolu göstereceğim. Artı, önemli birine de tanıştıracağım seni. Öyle bağlantılar ağaçta yetişmiyor.
tu.68c4212eab4116a9f2e697df: İş bitti. Farelerin olup olmadığından emin değilim ama.
tu.68c42144a276634e966231d4: Harbiden çok iyi iş çıkarmışsın! O şaşkınlardan biri sürüne sürüne gelip af diledi, diğeri de mermi yedi. Senin işin olabilir.
tu.68c421de1df280266f74af12: Teslim olmaya gelmiş. Niye böyle öldürdün ki?
tu.68c421ec1d2d6a33a77c645a: Ne oldun, ahlak filozofu mu? Tarkov’da bir kere çuvalladın mı biter. Bunu unutma, ufak tefek şeylerde sıçma.
tu.68c422015ff2e3e576ff38de: Opa, demek anlıyorsun! Benim seviyemde merhamete zaman yok, hele bu tarz ufak tefeklere hiç. Güvenimi sınamasan iyi olur.
tu.68c422ad2181f43516a73794: Beni o büyük adamla tanıştıracağını ve Shoreline yolunu göstereceğini söylemiştin.
tu.68c422cc05274c9ad5171b8d: Aynen öyle. Adamlarım seni oraya götürür, ben de — sadece ben — sana Peacekeeper’ın bağlantısını sağlarım, hehe!
tu.68c422da70c5f51811709b3f: UN falan mı bağlı bu herif?
tu.68c422e5d1933af49d69ed63: Evet, tıpkı diğerleri gibi! Barış düzen falan anlatır ama Avrupa malını gizliden satar, kendi çıkarını korur. Fazla rahatlama yanında.
tu.68c4230731915b86d52f9e69: Çalışıyor ama öyle herkesle çamura bulaşmaz. Şimdilik sadece seninle takas yapar, başka hiçbir şey yok. Belki sonra, benim üzerinden doğru düzgün bir anlaşma yaparsın.

ru.68c4203b9f2ed4643489905e: Раз ты тут, значит есть у нас ещё шансы сработаться. Делюга такая: я нашёл крыс, которые слили налево координаты нашего склада.
ru.68c42053572026c2e2f9f263: В том-то и проблема. Они сразу после атаки свалили, а вместо себя пару трупов в огне оставили. Мы только вчера подмену спалили.
ru.68c420716419d41fdd34c39c: Этих гандонов видели по дороге в лес, так что там и искать надо. Сами они шестёрками были, кроме склада ничего и не видели. Но сам понимаешь, такое говно на тормозах спускать нельзя.
ru.68c4208abe79232b3d61920e: Чтобы ты пошуршал в лесу, и уложил кого-нибудь. Мне нужно, чтобы все знали – кто Лыжника прокинет, не жилец больше! Если крыс моих найдёшь, мочи. Если кого-то другого уложишь, тоже сойдёт.
ru.68c420971546fc49a1c918c4: Понял тебя. А мне за это что будет?
ru.68c420ae3b8a46d85d97bf65: Ты же до порта добраться пытаешься? Так вот без тропок нужных ты к Берегу не выйдешь. А я тебе их покажу. Бонусом сведу с одним важным типом, такие связи на дороге не валяются.
ru.68c420c2aeff63337661a56a: Ладно, идёт. Жди новостей с леса.
ru.68c4212eab4116a9f2e697df: Я всё сделал. Не знаю только, твои это были люди или нет.
ru.68c42144a276634e966231d4: Нормально, нормально! Ко мне один из этих дебилов сам пришёл извиняться, второго подстрелили. Может это ты и был.
ru.68c421de1df280266f74af12: Он же сдаться пришёл. Зачем его в расход пускать?
ru.68c421ec1d2d6a33a77c645a: А ты чё, особо умный что ли? В Таркове таким лохам второго шанса не дают. Запомни это, и лучше не косячь по пустякам.
ru.68c421f6256605261d57d3e7: Всё правильно сделал. Таким нельзя доверять.
ru.68c422015ff2e3e576ff38de: Опа, а ты реально шаришь! На моём уровне нет времени сюсюкаться с такой мелочью. Так что доверие моё лучше не испытывать.
ru.68c422ad2181f43516a73794: Ты говорил, что с какой-то важной шишкой меня сведёшь и дорогу к Берегу покажешь.
ru.68c422cc05274c9ad5171b8d: Это да. Маршрут тебе мои пацаны подскажут, а вот контакт Миротворца уже никто кроме меня не даст, хе-хе!
ru.68c422da70c5f51811709b3f: Он что, как-то связан с ООН?
ru.68c422e5d1933af49d69ed63: Ага, связан, как и все они! На словах за мир во всём мире, а по факту снарягу европейскую сливает в крысу, и интересы свои закрывает. Так что ты с ним не расслабляйся.
ru.68c4230731915b86d52f9e69: Ага, но с кем попало в говно не полезет. Пока что он готов с тобой только поторговать, не больше. Может быть, позже сможешь через меня договориться о нормальном сотрудничестве.

ro.68c4203b9f2ed4643489905e: Since you’re here, there’s still hope for us to work together. Here’s the score: I found the rats who leaked our warehouse coordinates.
ro.68c42053572026c2e2f9f263: That’s the catch. They legged it right after the hit and left a couple of burning corpses as decoys. We only twigged the swap yesterday.
ro.68c4205ec704a7df462afe74: Any idea where they are now?
ro.68c420716419d41fdd34c39c: Those fucks were spotted heading into the Woods, so that’s where you’ll find them. They’re just small-time runners, didn’t know much past the warehouse. But still, can’t let that shit slide.
ro.68c42079129f4fda771a90f2: What do you want me to do?
ro.68c4208abe79232b3d61920e: To make some noise in that forest and drop someone. I want everyone to know that crossing Skier is a death wish! If you find those two rat cunts — good, fuck them up. But I don’t really care who you kill.
ro.68c420971546fc49a1c918c4: Got it. And what’s in it for me?
ro.68c420ae3b8a46d85d97bf65: You’re still trying to reach the port, right? Without the right paths you won’t even make it to Shoreline. I’ll point you the way. Plus, I’ll introduce you to someone important. Connections like that don’t grow on trees.
ro.68c420c2aeff63337661a56a: Alright, deal. I’ll bring news from the Woods.
ro.68c4212eab4116a9f2e697df: Job’s done. Not sure if they were your rats, though.
ro.68c42144a276634e966231d4: Proper good fucking job! One of those muppets crawled to me himself begging for forgiveness, the other one caught a bullet. Might’ve been your handiwork.
ro.68c421c0a694a422b7932699: And what happened to the one who came to you?
ro.68c421cf573334253d7e141f: I put him down, of course!
ro.68c421de1df280266f74af12: He came to surrender. Why kill him like that?
ro.68c421ec1d2d6a33a77c645a: What, you some kind of moral philosopher now? In Tarkov, you screw up once, and that’s it. Remember that, and don’t mess up over small stuff.
ro.68c421f6256605261d57d3e7: Good call. You can’t trust rats like him.
ro.68c422015ff2e3e576ff38de: Opa, looks like you get it! At my level there’s no time for mercy, especially for small fry like them. Best not to test my trust.
ro.68c422ad2181f43516a73794: You said you’d hook me up with some big shot and show me the way to Shoreline.
ro.68c422cc05274c9ad5171b8d: That’s right. My lads will guide you there, while I, and only I, can get you Peacekeeper’s contact, hehe!
ro.68c422da70c5f51811709b3f: Is he tied to the UN or something?
ro.68c422e5d1933af49d69ed63: Yeah, like all of them! Talks peace and order, but he’s flogging European kit under the table, covering his own interests. Don’t get too comfy around him.
ro.68c4230731915b86d52f9e69: He does, but he won’t wade through muck with just anyone. For now he’ll only do trades with you, nothing else. Maybe later, through me, you’ll strike a proper deal.

ch.68c7ebc7be1755657fdae467: 你给我发了消息，难道港口区那边有新情况了？
ch.68c7ebd08739bb11f8364218: 是的。我检查了港口附近的通道。你撤离的机会几乎为零，所以我觉得，既然你一时半会走不掉，不如我们多勾兑勾兑。
ch.68c7ebddab53327c35cf100e: 我已经看过那边的情况。士兵们非常警惕。
ch.68c7ebeb3f843ff0af10b1cf: 如果你真的打算离开，容易的路线早就被堵死了。要想冲破封锁线，你就得和某些特定的人搭上联系，那些真正掌控着这座城市的人。
ch.68c7ec0666a6e102431119a7: 能介绍几个这样的大佬让我认识吗？
ch.68c7ec112957a4bba5d27f9e: 可能吧，现在把话说太满未免太早了。但除非你知道路线，否则你永远别想靠近灯塔。
ch.68c7ec2891b3233203366619: 为什么我必须经过灯塔才能见到那些大人物？
ch.68c7ec3043d2b42a09bae421: 装备、武器、情报……当 USEC 刚登陆那里时，他们留下了许多值钱的东西。所以我决定和 Peacekeeper 做一笔交易，让他为你安排一条安全通道。
ch.68c7ec3acaaf9408125262f9: 希望我不会后悔这个“交易”。
ch.68c7ec4794df2775e414efe5: 你当然不会后悔的。去灯塔的捷径太危险了，但 Peacekeeper 同意，只要你能“资助”UNTAR 在当地的行动，他就会替你清理出一条道路来。他肯定是不会亲自见你的，但会为你提供一条安全通道，当然是通过我这里告诉你。
ch.68c7ec6f2d17ef5f2156506d: 不少。但你迟早会赚回来的。
ch.68c7ec81931f1d0f19c41dc5: 我身上没那么多！（募集 20,000 美元）
ch.68c7ec8bff163638450d3f5c: 那就等你凑齐钱再来。我一直是这个价。
ch.68c7ec9935ec36f000377fe4: 我有现金了。怎么给你？（上交 20,000 美元）
ch.68c7ecadd8e232fb237c82cd: 放这里。我会处理剩下的。
ch.68c7ecc336e358b2fc2af236: 我有现金。怎么给你？（上交20,000 美元）
ch.68fa601482e0a9bd3c3104d8: 听过这个名字。跟我说说他。
ch.68fa60300d9893bffd7b5824: UNTAR 在塔科夫的维和行动代表。官方层面上，他代表了联合国的利益，在塔科夫维持秩序什么的。但实际上，这个人唯一感兴趣的只有给自己捞钱。

cz.68c7ebc7be1755657fdae467: Volal jsi mi. Máš nějaký zprávy o Terminálu?
cz.68c7ebd08739bb11f8364218: Jo. Prověřil jsem si svoje kanály ohledně přístavu. Tvoje šance na evakuaci odtamtud je skoro nulová, tak jsem si říkal, že je na čase utvrdit naše známost.
cz.68c7ebddab53327c35cf100e: Už jsem tam byl. Vojáci chtěj nějakej průkaz.
cz.68c7ebeb3f843ff0af10b1cf: Jestli se fakt chceš dostat ven, tak ty snadný cesty už jsou dávno pryč. Aby ses dostal přes ty těžký, budeš potřebovat určitý lidi. Ty, co tady doopravdy vládnou.
cz.68c7ec0666a6e102431119a7: Můžeš mě spojit s někým takhle vysoko?
cz.68c7ec112957a4bba5d27f9e: Možná. Ještě je brzo říkat. Ale na ten Lighthouse se určitě nikdy nedostaneš, pokud nebudeš znát cestu.
cz.68c7ec2891b3233203366619: Proč bych potřeboval ten Lighthouse, když je pro mě ještě brzo na setkání s velkejma šéfama?
cz.68c7ec3043d2b42a09bae421: Vybavení, zbraně, informace… Potom, co se tam poprvý vylodili USEC, nechali tam spoustu cenných věcí. Takže jsem se rozhodl udělat dohodu s Peacekeeperem, aby ti zařídil bezpečnej průchod.
cz.68c7ec4794df2775e414efe5: Nebudeš. Ta krátká cesta k Lighthousu je teď moc nebezpečná, ale Peacekeeper souhlasil, že uvolní cestu výměnou za „investici“ do mise UNTAR. Nechce se s tebou setkat osobně, ale skrze mě ti zajistí bezpečnej koridor.
cz.68c7ec6f2d17ef5f2156506d: Docela dost. Ale včas se ti to vrátí.
cz.68c7ec8bff163638450d3f5c: Tak se vrať, až je budeš mít. Ta nabídka zůstává otevřená.
cz.68c7ec9935ec36f000377fe4: Mám ty prachy. Jak ti je mám předat? (Předat 20 000 USD)
cz.68c7ecadd8e232fb237c82cd: Nech to tady. Já se o zbytek postarám.
cz.68c7ecc336e358b2fc2af236: Mám ty prachy. Jak ti je mám předat? (Předat 20 000 USD)
cz.68fa601482e0a9bd3c3104d8: Slyšel jsem to jméno. Řekni mi o něm.
cz.68fa60300d9893bffd7b5824: Zástupce mírové mise UNTAR v Tarkovu. Oficiálně chrání zájmy OSN. Ve skutečnosti slouží svým vlastním.

en.68c7ebc7be1755657fdae467: You called me. Got any news about the Terminal?
en.68c7ebd08739bb11f8364218: Yes. I checked my channels about the port. Your chance of evacuation there is almost zero, so I thought it was time to firm up our acquaintance.
en.68c7ebddab53327c35cf100e: I've already been there. The soldiers are asking for some pass.
en.68c7ebeb3f843ff0af10b1cf: If you truly plan on getting out, the easy ways are long gone. To break through the hard ones, you will need certain people. The ones really running this city.
en.68c7ec0666a6e102431119a7: You can connect me with someone that high up?
en.68c7ec112957a4bba5d27f9e: Possibly. Too early to say. But you will certainly never reach the Lighthouse unless you know the route.
en.68c7ec2891b3233203366619: Why would I need that Lighthouse if it's too early for me to meet the big shots?

fr.68c7ebc7be1755657fdae467: Vous m’avez fait appeler. Des nouvelles concernant le terminal ?
fr.68c7ebd08739bb11f8364218: Oui. J’ai vérifié mes réseaux à propos du port. Vos chances d’évacuation là-bas sont presque nulles, alors j’ai pensé qu’il était temps de renforcer notre relation.
fr.68c7ebddab53327c35cf100e: J’y suis déjà allé. Les soldats demandent un laissez-passer.
fr.68c7ebeb3f843ff0af10b1cf: Si tu comptes vraiment sortir d’ici, les chemins faciles sont depuis longtemps hors de portée. Pour forcer les plus difficiles, tu auras besoin de certaines personnes. Celles qui dirigent réellement cette ville.
fr.68c7ec0666a6e102431119a7: Vous pouvez me mettre en relation avec quelqu’un d’aussi haut placé ?
fr.68c7ec112957a4bba5d27f9e: Peut-être. Trop tôt pour le dire. Mais tu n’atteindras jamais le phare sans connaître l’itinéraire.
fr.68c7ec2891b3233203366619: Pourquoi aurais-je besoin de ce phare s’il est trop tôt pour rencontrer les gros poissons ?
fr.68c7ec3043d2b42a09bae421: Équipement, armes, renseignements… Après le premier débarquement des USEC là-bas, ils ont laissé pas mal de choses de valeur. J’ai donc décidé de conclure un accord avec Peacekeeper pour t' assurer un passage sûr.
fr.68c7ec3acaaf9408125262f9: J’espère que je ne regretterai pas cet « accord ».
fr.68c7ec4794df2775e414efe5: Tu  ne le regretteras pas. Le chemin direct vers le phare est trop dangereux actuellement, mais Peacekeeper a accepté de dégager la route en échange d’un « investissement » dans la mission UNTAR. Il ne souhaite pas te rencontrer en personne, mais par mon intermédiaire, il te fournira un corridor sécurisé.
fr.68c7ec6f2d17ef5f2156506d: Une sacrée somme. Mais tu la récupéreras avec le temps.
fr.68c7ec81931f1d0f19c41dc5: Je n’ai pas autant sur moi ! (Récolter 20 000 Dollars)
fr.68c7ec8bff163638450d3f5c: Alors reviens quand tu les auras. L’offre reste valable.
fr.68c7ec9935ec36f000377fe4: J’ai l’argent, comment est-ce que je le transfère ? (Donner 20 000 Dollars)
fr.68c7ecadd8e232fb237c82cd: Laisse-le ici. Je m’occupe du reste.
fr.68c7ecc336e358b2fc2af236: J’ai l’argent, comment est-ce que je le transfère ? (Donner 20 000 Dollars)
fr.68fa601482e0a9bd3c3104d8: J’ai déjà entendu ce nom. Dîtes m'en plus
fr.68fa60300d9893bffd7b5824: Un représentant de la mission de maintien de la paix UNTAR à Tarkov. Officiellement, il protège les intérêts de l’ONU. En réalité, il sert les siens.

it.68c7ebc7be1755657fdae467: Mi hai chiamato. Hai notizie sul Terminale?
it.68c7ebd08739bb11f8364218: Sì. Ho controllato i miei canali riguardo al porto. Le tue possibilità di evacuazione lì sono quasi nulle, quindi ho pensato che fosse il momento di consolidare la nostra conoscenza.
it.68c7ebddab53327c35cf100e: Ci sono già stato. I soldati chiedono un lasciapassare.
it.68c7ebeb3f843ff0af10b1cf: Se hai davvero intenzione di andartene, i modi facili sono ormai lontani. Per superare quelli difficili, avrai bisogno di certe persone. Quelle che gestiscono davvero questa città.
it.68c7ec0666a6e102431119a7: Puoi mettermi in contatto con qualcuno così in alto?
it.68c7ec112957a4bba5d27f9e: Forse. È troppo presto per dirlo. Ma di sicuro non raggiungerai mai il Faro se non conosci la strada.
it.68c7ec2891b3233203366619: Perché dovrei aver bisogno di quel Faro se è troppo presto per me per incontrare i pezzi grossi?
it.68c7ec3043d2b42a09bae421: Equipaggiamento, armi, informazioni... Dopo che l'USEC è sbarcata lì per la prima volta, ha lasciato molte cose di valore. Quindi ho deciso di fare un accordo con Peacekeeper per organizzare un passaggio sicuro per te.
it.68c7ec3acaaf9408125262f9: Spero di non pentirmi di questo "accordo".
it.68c7ec4794df2775e414efe5: Non lo farai. Il percorso breve per raggiungere il Faro è troppo pericoloso ora, ma Peacekeeper ha accettato di liberare la strada in cambio di un "investimento" nella missione UNTAR. Non vuole incontrarti di persona, ma tramite me ti fornirà un corridoio sicuro.
it.68c7ec6f2d17ef5f2156506d: Abbastanza. Ma ce la farai in tempo.
it.68c7ec81931f1d0f19c41dc5: Non ho così tanti soldi con me! (Raccogli 20.000 USD)
it.68c7ec8bff163638450d3f5c: Una volta fatto, torna qui. L'offerta è ancora valida.
it.68c7ec9935ec36f000377fe4: Ho i soldi. Come faccio a consegnarli? (Consegna 20.000 USD)
it.68c7ecadd8e232fb237c82cd: Lascialo qui. Al resto ci penso io.
it.68c7ecc336e358b2fc2af236: Ho i soldi. Come faccio a consegnarli? (Consegna 20.000 USD)
it.68fa601482e0a9bd3c3104d8: Ho sentito il nome. Parlami di lui.
it.68fa60300d9893bffd7b5824: Un rappresentante della missione di pace UNTAR a Tarkov. Ufficialmente protegge gli interessi delle Nazioni Unite. In realtà, serve i propri.

jp.68c7ebc7be1755657fdae467: 連絡をこっちにしたんだ、Terminal について何か情報はあるか？
jp.68c7ebd08739bb11f8364218: ああ、港の情報は見てみたんだけど、君が撤退できる可能性がほとんどないから、ここで仲良くべきだとね。
jp.68c7ebddab53327c35cf100e: もうそこに行ってきた。兵士がパスを求めてくるんだ。
jp.68c7ebeb3f843ff0af10b1cf: もし本当に脱出するつもりなら、簡単な方法はないはずだ。この難しい状況を何とかするなら、特定の人物を頼ることになる。この都市を真に支配している人たちをね。
jp.68c7ec0666a6e102431119a7: そんな高位な人間とも繋げてくれるんだろう？
jp.68c7ec112957a4bba5d27f9e: 時期尚早だから断言はできないけどね。だけど道を知らないと Lighthouse には決して行けないよ。
jp.68c7ec2891b3233203366619: 俺が大物に合うには早すぎるんだとすると、なぜ今 Lighthouse が必要になるんだ？
jp.68c7ec3043d2b42a09bae421: 装備や武器、情報 ... USEC 先に降りた後に結構なものを置いて行ったんだ。だから僕は Peacekeeper と取引して、君の為に安全なルートを作ることにしたんだ。
jp.68c7ec3acaaf9408125262f9: この「取引」、後悔しなければいいんだが。
jp.68c7ec4794df2775e414efe5: 心配する必要はないよ。灯台へ行く短い道は今や危険すぎるんだ。だけど Peacekeeper は UNTAR ミッションへの投資と引きかえに安全に通れるようにすることを約束したんだ。彼は直接会いたくはないそうだけど、僕を通じて安全なルートを提供してくれるよ。
jp.68c7ec550c73d12853b734a7: それなら払わないとな。いくらなんだ？
jp.68c7ec6f2d17ef5f2156506d: かなりの額だけど、すぐに戻ってこれるはずだ。
jp.68c7ec81931f1d0f19c41dc5: 手元にそこまでのお金はないな！(20,000 ドルを集める)
jp.68c7ec8bff163638450d3f5c: なら終わったら戻ってきてくれ。オファーはまだあるからね。
jp.68c7ec9935ec36f000377fe4: 金を持ってきた。どう渡せばいい？ (20,000 ドルを渡す)
jp.68c7ecadd8e232fb237c82cd: ここにおいてくれ。後はこちらに任せてくれ。
jp.68c7ecc336e358b2fc2af236: 金を持ってきた。どう渡せばいい？ (20,000 ドルを渡す)
jp.68fa601482e0a9bd3c3104d8: 名前は聞いた。そいつについて教えてくれ。
jp.68fa60300d9893bffd7b5824: タルコフで UNTAR ピースキーピングミッション を行っているその代表だね。公式には UN の利益を守る役割だけれど、実際は自身のことが優先のようだ。

kr.68c7ebc7be1755657fdae467: 날 불렀던데. 터미널에 관한 소식이 있나?
kr.68c7ebd08739bb11f8364218: 그래. 내 인맥을 동원해서 항구에 관해 알아봤는데, 거기서 자네가 탈출할 수 있는 확률은 제로에 가깝더라고. 그러니 이젠 본격적으로 협력 관계를 다질 때가 된 것 같네.
kr.68c7ebddab53327c35cf100e: 내가 직접 가 봤는데, 거기 있는 병사들이 무슨 통행증 같은 걸 요구하더라.
kr.68c7ebeb3f843ff0af10b1cf: 혹시 여기서 정말로 나갈 생각이라면, 쉬운 방법은 이젠 없다고 봐야 할 거야. 그 험난한 길을 뚫고 나가려면 특정 사람들의 도움이 필요할 거야. 이 도시를 실제로 움직이게 하는 사람들 말이야.
kr.68c7ec0666a6e102431119a7: 혹시 나를 그런 사람들이랑 연결시켜 줄 수 있어?
kr.68c7ec112957a4bba5d27f9e: 지금 당장은 확답하긴 이르지만, 아마도. 하지만 확실한 건 가는 길을 모른다면 자네는 절대 등대에 도달하지 못 할 거야.
kr.68c7ec2891b3233203366619: 거물들을 만나기 이르다면서, 내가 왜 등대로 가야 하는 거지?
kr.68c7ec3043d2b42a09bae421: 장비라던가, 무기나 정보라던가… USEC이 그 곳에 처음으로 거점을 잡은 이후로 가치 있는 것들을 많이 남겨두었거든. 그래서 자네한테 안전한 통행료를 마련해 주려고 내가 피스키퍼와 거래를 좀 했지.
kr.68c7ec4794df2775e414efe5: 후회할 일은 없을 거야. 등대로 가는 가장 빠른 길은 지금 당장은 매우 위험하지만, 피스키퍼가 UNTAR의 임무에 대한 '투자'를 대가로 길을 열어주기로 합의했거든. 그가 자네를 직접 대면으로 만나길 원치는 않지만, 나를 통해서 안전한 길을 열어줄 거야.
kr.68c7ec550c73d12853b734a7: 그 말인 즉, 돈을 내야 한다는 소리로 들리네. 얼마지?
kr.68c7ec6f2d17ef5f2156506d: 꽤 많이 내야 할 거야. 하지만 원금보다 더 많이 벌어들일 수 있을 거야.
kr.68c7ec81931f1d0f19c41dc5: 나한테 그만한 돈은 지금은 없어! (20,000 달러 모아오기)
kr.68c7ec8bff163638450d3f5c: 그러면 돈을 낼 준비가 되면 돌아와. 거래는 여전히 유효하니까.
kr.68c7ec9935ec36f000377fe4: 돈을 가져왔다. 어떻게 전달하면 되지? (20,000 달러 지불하기)
kr.68c7ecc336e358b2fc2af236: 돈을 가져왔다. 어떻게 전달하면 되지? (20,000 달러 지불하기)
kr.68fa601482e0a9bd3c3104d8: 어디서 들어본 적 있는 이름인데. 좀 더 알려줘봐.
kr.68fa60300d9893bffd7b5824: 타르코프에서 평화유지군 임무로 파견된 UNTAR의 대리인이야. 공식적으로는 UN의 이익을 보호한다곤 하지만, 실상은 자기 잇속을 채우고 있지.

po.68c7ebc7be1755657fdae467: Você me chamou. Tem novidades sobre o Terminal?
po.68c7ebd08739bb11f8364218: Sim. Consultei meus canais sobre o porto. Suas chances de evacuação por lá são quase zero, então achei que era hora de firmar nossa parceria.
po.68c7ebddab53327c35cf100e: Já estive lá. Os soldados estão pedindo algum tipo de passe.
po.68c7ebeb3f843ff0af10b1cf: Se você realmente planeja sair daqui, os caminhos fáceis já se foram há tempos. Para forçar as saídas difíceis, vai precisar de certas pessoas. As que realmente mandam nessa cidade.
po.68c7ec0666a6e102431119a7: Você pode me conectar com alguém assim tão influente?
po.68c7ec112957a4bba5d27f9e: Talvez. Cedo demais pra dizer. Mas com certeza você nunca vai chegar ao Lighthouse sem saber a rota.
po.68c7ec2891b3233203366619: Por que eu precisaria daquele farol se ainda é cedo demais pra encontrar os figurões?
po.68c7ec3043d2b42a09bae421: Equipamento, armas, informações… Depois que o USEC desembarcou lá pela primeira vez, deixaram muita coisa valiosa para trás. Então decidi fazer um acordo com o Peacekeeper pra arranjar uma passagem segura pra você.
po.68c7ec4794df2775e414efe5: Não vai. O caminho curto até o Lighthouse está muito perigoso agora, mas o Peacekeeper concordou em abrir o caminho em troca de um 'investimento' na missão UNTAR. Ele não quer te encontrar pessoalmente, mas através de mim vai providenciar um corredor seguro.
po.68c7ec6f2d17ef5f2156506d: Bastante coisa. Mas você vai recuperar com o tempo.
po.68c7ec81931f1d0f19c41dc5: Não tenho tudo isso comigo! (Juntar 20.000 USD)
po.68c7ec8bff163638450d3f5c: Então volte quando tiver. A oferta continua de pé.
po.68c7ec9935ec36f000377fe4: Tenho o dinheiro. Como eu passo pra você? (Entregar 20.000 USD)
po.68c7ecadd8e232fb237c82cd: Deixa aqui. Eu cuido do resto.
po.68c7ecc336e358b2fc2af236: Tenho o dinheiro. Como eu passo pra você? (Entregar 20.000 USD)
po.68fa601482e0a9bd3c3104d8: Ouvi o nome. Me fale sobre ele.
po.68fa60300d9893bffd7b5824: Um representante da missão de paz da UNTAR em Tarkov. Oficialmente ele protege os interesses da UN. Na prática, serve aos seus próprios.

sk.68c7ebc7be1755657fdae467: You called me. Got any news about the Terminal?
sk.68c7ebd08739bb11f8364218: Yes. I checked my channels about the port. Your chance of evacuation there is almost zero, so I thought it was time to firm up our acquaintance.
sk.68c7ebddab53327c35cf100e: I've already been there. The soldiers are asking for some pass.
sk.68c7ebeb3f843ff0af10b1cf: If you truly plan on getting out, the easy ways are long gone. To break through the hard ones, you will need certain people. The ones really running this city.
sk.68c7ec0666a6e102431119a7: You can connect me with someone that high up?
sk.68c7ec112957a4bba5d27f9e: Possibly. Too early to say. But you will certainly never reach the Lighthouse unless you know the route.
sk.68c7ec2891b3233203366619: Why would I need that Lighthouse if it's too early for me to meet the big shots?
sk.68c7ec3043d2b42a09bae421: Equipment, weapons, intel… After the USEC first disembarked there, they left many valuable things. So I decided to make a deal with Peacekeeper to arrange a safe passage for you.
sk.68c7ec4794df2775e414efe5: You will not. The short path to the Lighthouse is too dangerous now, but Peacekeeper agreed to clear the way in exchange for an “investment” in the UNTAR mission. He does not want to meet you himself, but through me he will provide a safe corridor.
sk.68c7ec550c73d12853b734a7: So I have to pay. How much?
sk.68c7ec6f2d17ef5f2156506d: Quite a lot. But you will make it back in time.
sk.68c7ec81931f1d0f19c41dc5: I don’t have that much on me! (Gather 20,000 USD)
sk.68c7ec8bff163638450d3f5c: Then come back once you do. The offer stays open.
sk.68c7ec9935ec36f000377fe4: I have the cash. How do I pass it on? (Hand over 20,000 USD)
sk.68c7ecadd8e232fb237c82cd: Leave it here. I will handle the rest.
sk.68c7ecc336e358b2fc2af236: I have the cash. How do I pass it on? (Hand over 20,000 USD)
sk.68fa601482e0a9bd3c3104d8: Heard the name. Tell me about him.
sk.68fa60300d9893bffd7b5824: A representative of the UNTAR peacekeeping mission in Tarkov. Officially he protects UN interests. In reality, he serves his own.

es.68c7ebc7be1755657fdae467: Me has llamado. ¿Tienes alguna novedad sobre Terminal?
es.68c7ebd08739bb11f8364218: Sí. He revisado la información sobre el puerto a través de mis contactos. Las posibilidades de evacuación desde allí son prácticamente nulas, así que pensé que sería un buen momento para consolidar nuestra asociación.
es.68c7ebddab53327c35cf100e: Ya he pasado por ahí. Los soldados piden alguna especie de pase.
es.68c7ebeb3f843ff0af10b1cf: Si realmente piensas salir de aquí, las vías fáciles ya no existen. Para abrirte paso entre las difíciles, necesitarás a ciertas personas. Las que realmente controlan esta ciudad.
es.68c7ec0666a6e102431119a7: ¿Puedes ponerme en contacto con alguien así de importante?
es.68c7ec112957a4bba5d27f9e: Es posible. Es demasiado pronto para saberlo con certeza. Pero lo que está claro es que nunca llegarás a Lighthouse si no conoces el camino.
es.68c7ec2891b3233203366619: ¿Por qué necesitaría ir a Lighthouse si aún es demasiado pronto como para conocer a los peces gordos?
es.68c7ec3043d2b42a09bae421: Equipamiento, armas, información… Después de que los USEC desembarcaran allí por primera vez, dejaron muchas cosas valiosas. Así que he decidido hacer un trato con Peacekeeper para facilitarte un camino seguro.
es.68c7ec4794df2775e414efe5: No lo harás. El camino corto hacia Lighthouse es demasiado peligroso en estos momentos, pero Peacekeeper accedió a despejarlo a cambio de una "inversión" en la misión UNTAR. No quiere reunirse contigo en persona, pero a través de mí te proporcionará un corredor seguro.
es.68c7ec6f2d17ef5f2156506d: Bastante. Pero lo recuperarás en poco tiempo.
es.68c7ec8bff163638450d3f5c: Entonces, regresa cuando la hagas. La oferta sigue en pie.
es.68c7ec9935ec36f000377fe4: Tengo el dinero. ¿Cómo se lo entrego? (Entrega 20.000 Dólares)
es.68c7ecadd8e232fb237c82cd: Déjalo aquí. Yo me encargo del resto.
es.68c7ecc336e358b2fc2af236: Tengo el dinero. ¿Cómo se lo entrego? (Entrega 20.000 Dólares)
es.68fa601482e0a9bd3c3104d8: He escuchado ese nombre. Cuéntame sobre él.
es.68fa60300d9893bffd7b5824: Es un representante de la misión de paz UNTAR en Tarkov. Oficialmente, protege los intereses de la ONU. En realidad, vela por sus propios intereses.

tu.68c7ebc7be1755657fdae467: Beni çağırmıştın. Terminal hakkında bir haber var mı?
tu.68c7ebd08739bb11f8364218: Evet. Limanla ilgili hatlarımdan bilgi aldım. Oradan tahliye olma şansın neredeyse sıfır, o yüzden tanışıklığımızı biraz daha resmileştirmenin zamanı geldiğini düşündüm.
tu.68c7ebddab53327c35cf100e: Ben zaten gittim oraya. Askerler bir geçiş belgesi istiyor.
tu.68c7ebeb3f843ff0af10b1cf: Gerçekten gitmeyi düşünüyorsan kolay yollar çoktan kapandı. Zor olanlarını aşmak için bu şehri yöneten bazı kişilere ihtiyacın olacak.
tu.68c7ec0666a6e102431119a7: Bu kadar üst seviye biriyle bağlantı kurmamı sağlayabilir misin?
tu.68c7ec112957a4bba5d27f9e: Muhtemelen. Şimdilik söylemek için erken. Ama Lighthouse’a giden yolu bilmeden oraya asla gidemezsin.
tu.68c7ec2891b3233203366619: Bu “büyük adamları” görmek için erkense o Lighthouse bana niye lazım?
tu.68c7ec3043d2b42a09bae421: Ekipman, silahlar, istihbarat… USEC ilk oraya çıkartma yaptığında bir sürü değerli şey bırakmıştı. O yüzden Peacekeeper’la anlaşma yapıp sana güvenli geçiş ayarlamaya karar verdim.
tu.68c7ec4794df2775e414efe5: Olmazsın. Lighthouse’a kısa yol şu an çok tehlikeli ama Peacekeeper, UNTAR görevi için bir “yatırım” karşılığında yolu temizlemeyi kabul etti. Seninle birebir görüşmek istemiyor ama benim üzerimden güvenli bir koridor sağlayacak.
tu.68c7ec550c73d12853b734a7: Yani para vermem gerekiyor. Ne kadar?
tu.68c7ec81931f1d0f19c41dc5: Üstümde o kadar yok! (20.000 USD topla)
tu.68c7ec8bff163638450d3f5c: O zaman eline geçince gel. Teklif geçerli.
tu.68c7ec9935ec36f000377fe4: Param var. Nasıl teslim edeceğim? (20.000 USD ver)
tu.68c7ecc336e358b2fc2af236: Param var. Nasıl teslim edeceğim? (20.000 USD ver)
tu.68fa60300d9893bffd7b5824: UNTAR barışı koruma misyonunun Tarkov’daki temsilcisi. Resmi olarak BM çıkarlarını koruyor. Gerçekte ise kendi çıkarlarına çalışıyor.

ru.68c7ebc7be1755657fdae467: Ты меня звал. Есть новости по поводу Терминала?
ru.68c7ebd08739bb11f8364218: Да. Я пробил по своим каналам информацию насчёт порта. Шансов на эвакуацию у тебя крайне мало, поэтому я решил, что закрепить наше знакомство будет не лишним.
ru.68c7ebddab53327c35cf100e: Я уже там был. Военные требуют какой-то пропуск.
ru.68c7ebeb3f843ff0af10b1cf: Если ты и правда намерен выбраться отсюда, то простых путей у тебя уже не осталось. А чтобы пробиться по-сложному, тебе понадобятся некоторые люди. Те, кто на самом деле контролирует ситуацию в городе.
ru.68c7ec0666a6e102431119a7: Ты можешь свести меня с кем-то настолько серьёзным?
ru.68c7ec112957a4bba5d27f9e: Может быть. Сейчас ещё слишком рано судить. Но ты точно не сможешь добраться до Маяка, если не будешь знать дорогу.
ru.68c7ec2891b3233203366619: А что там такого ценного, если к важным людям ещё рано заходить?
ru.68c7ec3043d2b42a09bae421: Оборудование, вооружение, данные… После высадки USEC там осталось немало полезных вещей. Так что я решил договориться с Миротворцем о безопасном маршруте для тебя.
ru.68c7ec3acaaf9408125262f9: Надеюсь, я не пожалею об этом “договоре”.
ru.68c7ec4794df2775e414efe5: Это вряд ли. Короткая дорога к Маяку сейчас слишком опасна, но Миротворец готов зачистить подходы в обмен на “инвестицию” в миссию UNTAR. Он не готов общаться с тобой лично, но предоставит безопасный коридор при моём посредничестве.
ru.68c7ec6f2d17ef5f2156506d: Немало. Но со временем ты отобьёшь все вложенные деньги.
ru.68c7ec81931f1d0f19c41dc5: У меня нет таких денег! (Собрать 20 тыс. долларов)
ru.68c7ec8bff163638450d3f5c: Тогда возвращайся, когда соберёшь. Это сделка остаётся открытой.
ru.68c7ec9935ec36f000377fe4: У меня есть деньги. Как я их передам? (передать 20 тыс. долларов)
ru.68c7ecadd8e232fb237c82cd: Оставь их здесь. Я всё сделаю.
ru.68c7ecc336e358b2fc2af236: У меня есть деньги. Как я их передам? (передать 20 тыс. долларов)
ru.68fa601482e0a9bd3c3104d8: Слышал про него. Что можешь о нём сказать?
ru.68fa60300d9893bffd7b5824: Представитель миротворческой миссии UNTAR в Таркове. Формально он защищает интересы ООН. Фактически – реализует свои.

ch.68c802e84628689dc645076e: 是啊，看得出来了。你叫我来这儿。是要给我安排任务吗？
ch.68c802f27696a4988e1a27bd: 当然！你的技巧可是让 Mechanic 印象深刻，所以我猜你的脑子还算好使，也不是完全没用。所以我准备让你执行一个战斗任务。
ch.68c8031ba457ce8b40da3222: 怎么，你觉得祖国母亲的感激还不够吗？
ch.68c803271a30e101ab964b28: 我看你一边歌颂祖国，一边要我干的这些事却和爱国根本搭不上一点关系。
ch.68c80333f34a826cf82da5ef: 新兵，你跟长官说话就是这种态度？
ch.68c8033d30eaa957914f51e0: 你不知道我的军衔，我也不听你指挥。别废话了，我们直接说正事吧
ch.68c803490805e50ab54fec21: 什么？我想揍你一顿也能做到！不过我先忍着。你只是个在这儿乱逛的游客。而且这任务非常紧急，没时间浪费。
ch.68c803e647a7672455dde23e: 像你这样的混蛋肯定做梦都想去储备基地，但这一次我得加个条件。
ch.68c80403838ea8b014f2569c: 基地里满是试图抢政府财产的掠夺者。我不想你到了那里之后变得和他们一样只知道偷窃和杀戮。答应我，如果你接了这个任务，你会像踩死蟑螂一样干掉那些混蛋。
ch.68c8040f590941d48b87f85f: 我本来就没打算和他们合作。我会做我该做的。
ch.68c8044e69f5e5803d34f7f3: 报酬已经谈妥了。那么这条路线的代价呢？
ch.68c80467487b9ae85e666954: 假设我接这任务。你会给奖励吗？
ch.68c8047290c359b960f2b47b: 你这游客还挺会做生意！不过在塔科夫，这不算坏事。我可以带你去个只有少数人知道的地方。
ch.68c8049f2dc34216e15f289f: 以前的一个储备基地，就是那种存放装备，战时动员起来的地方。我本来不想让你进去，但那里现在满是那些该死的掠夺者……也许你能稍微收拾一下那个地方。
ch.68c804ab98ce3a0e1a00624d: 那地方可能到处都是贵重的军事装备。你为什么不自己占下来？
ch.68c804b59c7e50d9a926d467: 你见过真正的军事基地吗？要守住那种地方，我至少需要现在三倍的人手，而且那还只是负责外围警戒！而且那片区域本身也不怎么舒服。只有 Glukhar 设法在那里扎了根。但即便如此，他也没控制住整个基地。
ch.68c804cd7dc073231a7f6597: 你知道他是个疯子就行。以前在海军服役过，还是海军步兵。他手下拉拢了一批身手不错的退伍兵，有好装备、有枪。要是对上了这帮人，你可得小心点。
ch.68c804e3f8e6de2988221e1a: 没有。契约战争之后，他就把当初参军宣过的誓言都抛在脑后了。在那之前他似乎还和当地政府当局闹过些麻烦……不过那大概只是传言，我是不太相信他会老老实实蹲局子。
ch.68c804ece1d8aee99334e225: 好吧，那你想让我为这条路线做什么？
ch.68c8051ef30cb54089187e43: 最近我的车队被袭击了。根据他们抢走的装备来看，很明显袭击者不只是路边杂兵。他们跑不了多远，我们还有机会抓到他们。
ch.68c805265ce41a8be856eb9b: 这场袭击发生在什么地方？
ch.68c8053ae66d6b1e4564657f: 海岸线那边有个健康疗养中心，”蔚蓝海岸“疗养院。以前是个不错的地方……总之，靠北的地方有一条公路，车队当时正往那边走。他们就是在那里被打的。
ch.68c80544a066d95d22fa4623: 所以，我要去侦查那片区域？
ch.68c8054f354c7cc4bfab5874: 去他妈的侦查！我要让那些敢惹我的白痴血债血偿，不是让你去开法庭。我要是犹豫一下，这附近所有白痴混混们都会涌过来。所有人都想分一杯羹，觊觎我的装备。
ch.68c809606cf6713f1daca76d: 不需要确认。很明显他们是 PMC，只是我不确定他们到底是哪一边的人——你捡到他们尸体上的狗牌时就知道了。把那些狗牌带给我，让我看看你是玩真的。
ch.68c80985e81a257cbec841e6: 都在这儿了。你的狗牌。（上交 PMC 狗牌）
ch.68c8099289aa273b9f150b6b: 很好，把它们给我……我听说你们这些佣兵上了战场就不守规矩。有些人一开始就决定“调整工作优先级”了。
ch.68c809ae122775a0aea90eaf: 好吧，这就说得通了。别人为什么要救你？你自己都差点没人管了。
ch.68c809c35b30da6dee6b62f1: 我可不会为他们的行为负责。PMC 本来就没有同一个目标，不同的人各有各的行事方法。
ch.68c809cd08bafb6c6739ea20: 他们本来就应该开始做你现在做的事，至少建立联系、找到落脚点。如果你懂得沟通、守信用，你在塔科夫也能混得不错。
ch.68c809df3161ec714979be3a: 你以为我不知道？在战乱时期，你需要严明的纪律和清醒的头脑。就像你现在这样，你在城里建立关系，在塔科夫扎根。不瞎搞、建立名声——这样才能走得远。
ch.68c809f1fcd78c08d50bd9f4: 说到这，我怎么才能到那个军事基地？
ch.68c80a1a13e657277a677f3b: 我的人会给你指路。之后就靠你自己了。储备站是危险又躁动的地方。

cz.68c802e84628689dc645076e: Jo, už jsem si toho všimnul. Kvůli tomu jsi mě sem volal. Máš pro mě prácičku?
cz.68c802f27696a4988e1a27bd: Jasně! Udělal jsi na Mechanika dojem svýma schopnostma, takže si myslím, že máš hlavu na správným místě a nejsi úplně k ničemu. Takže jsem ochotnej ti svěřit bojovou misi.
cz.68c80306e777cceaa1bda13d: Co z toho budu mít já?
cz.68c8031ba457ce8b40da3222: Cože, vděčnost od Matky Rusi ti teď nestačí?
cz.68c803271a30e101ab964b28: Pochybuju, že tvoje práce má něco společnýho s tou Matkou Rusí, o který zpíváš.
cz.68c80333f34a826cf82da5ef: Jak se opovažuješ takhle mluvit se staršíma, zelenáči?!
cz.68c8033d30eaa957914f51e0: Neznáš moji hodnost a nejsem pod tvým velením. Vraťme se k věci, jo?
cz.68c803490805e50ab54fec21: Cože? Mohl bych tě rozšlápnout na sračky, kdybych chtěl! Ale tentokrát ti to promíjím, protože jsi tu turista. Kromě toho je ten úkol hodně urgentní, není čas ztrácet čas.
cz.68c803e647a7672455dde23e: Zkurvysyna jako ty bude asi zajímat přístup na vojenskou základnu Reserve. Ale teď přidám ještě jednu podmínku.
cz.68c80403838ea8b014f2569c: Základna je plná vykradačů, co se snažej urvat státní majetek. Nepotřebuju tam dalšího idiota, jako jsou oni. Slib mi, že jestli se na tu misi vydáš, tak ty bastardy rozmáčkneš jako šváby.
cz.68c8040f590941d48b87f85f: Stejně jsem s nima neplánoval spolupracovat. Udělám, co budu moct.
cz.68c8044e69f5e5803d34f7f3: Odměna je dohodnuta. Co chceš za tu trasu na oplátku?
cz.68c80467487b9ae85e666954: Předpokládejme, že se toho úkolu ujmu. Nabízíš odměnu?
cz.68c8047290c359b960f2b47b: Na turisty jsi docela obchodník! Ale v Tarkově to není špatná věc. Můžu ti ukázat místo, o kterým ví jen pár lidí.
cz.68c8049f2dc34216e15f289f: Bývalá vojenská základna Reserve. Normálně bych tě tam nepustil, ale je to tam zamořený těma zkurvenejma vykradačema... možná bys to tam mohl trochu uklidit.
cz.68c804ab98ce3a0e1a00624d: To místo je asi plný cenných informací a vybavení. Nemůžeš si tu celou základnu vzít sám?
cz.68c804b59c7e50d9a926d467: Viděl jsi někdy zkurvenou vojenskou základnu? Abych udržel takhle velký místo, potřeboval bych aspoň třikrát víc lidí, než mám teď, a to jenom na hlídání perimetru! Navíc ta oblast sama o sobě není zrovna příjemná. Jenom Glukhar se tam dokázal usadit. A i tak, ani on nekontroluje celou základnu.
cz.68c804cd7dc073231a7f6597: Šílenej bastard. Sloužil u námořnictva. Shromáždil pár zkušenejch veteránů, s dobrým vybavením a zbraněma. Takže si na ně dávej bacha.
cz.68c804e3f8e6de2988221e1a: Ne. Během Válek Kontraktorů zapomněl na svou přísahu. A už předtím dělal problémy s místní správou... ale to jsou jenom fámy.
cz.68c804ece1d8aee99334e225: Dobře teda. Co ode mě chceš na oplátku za tu trasu?
cz.68c8051ef30cb54089187e43: Nedávno přepadli můj konvoj. Podle vybavení je jasný, že to nebyli jenom náhodný Scavové. Nemohli se dostat daleko, takže máme ještě šanci je chytit.
cz.68c8053ae66d6b1e4564657f: Na Shoreline je zdravotní resort, "Azure Coast". Bejvávalo to hezký místo... No nic, severně od něj je silnice, tam ten konvoj mířil. Někde tam je přepadli.
cz.68c8054f354c7cc4bfab5874: Ser na průzkum! Potřebuju ty idioty potrestat, ne pořádat soudní zasedání. Jestli budu čekat, objeví se tam každej vykradač v okolí. Každej chce kousek mýho vybavení.
cz.68c809606cf6713f1daca76d: Není třeba je identifikovat. Je jasný, že to byli PMC, i když si nejsem jistej, na který straně byli - to poznáš jistě, až získáš psí známky z jejich těl. Přines mi ty známky, ukaž mi, že to myslíš vážně.
cz.68c8096ad858fe87f240958f: Rozumím. Až to bude hotový, vrátím se.
cz.68c80985e81a257cbec841e6: Hotovo. Tady jsou tvoje psí známky. (Předat Psí známky PMC)
cz.68c8099289aa273b9f150b6b: Dobře, dej je sem... Slyšel jsem, že vy žoldáci jste ztratili kontakt s velením. Vypadá to, že se někteří z vás rozhodli hned změnit svoje "pracovní priority".
cz.68c809ae122775a0aea90eaf: No, to dává smysl. Jak jinak přežít, když tě nechali napospas smrti bez podpory?
cz.68c809c35b30da6dee6b62f1: Já za ně nezodpovídám. PMC se skládají z různých lidí s různými cíli.
cz.68c809cd08bafb6c6739ea20: Mohli by aspoň začít dělat to, co ty! Zajistit si kontakty, udělat si bezpečný úkryt. Pokud umíš komunikovat a dodržet slovo, můžeš se mít dobře i v Tarkově.
cz.68c809df3161ec714979be3a: Myslíš, že to nevím? V dobách války potřebuješ pořádnou disciplínu a jasnou hlavu. Třeba jako ty: buduješ si kontakty, usazuješ se ve městě. Nedělej bordel a získej si reputaci - to tě dostane daleko.
cz.68c809f1fcd78c08d50bd9f4: Když už o tom mluvíme. Jak se dostanu na tu vojenskou základnu?
cz.68c80a1a13e657277a677f3b: Moji lidi ti ukážou cestu. Potom už jsi sám za sebe. Reserve je nebezpečný, neklidný místo.

en.68c802e84628689dc645076e: Yeah, noticed that already. You called me here. Got a job for me?
en.68c802f27696a4988e1a27bd: Of course! You impressed Mechanic with your skills, so I figure your head’s in the right place and you aren’t completely useless. So I’m ready to trust you with a combat mission.
en.68c80306e777cceaa1bda13d: What do I get in return?
en.68c8031ba457ce8b40da3222: What, gratitude from the Motherland isn’t enough for you now?
en.68c803271a30e101ab964b28: I doubt your work has anything to do with the Motherland you're singing about.
en.68c80333f34a826cf82da5ef: How dare you talk to your seniors like that, rookie?!
en.68c8033d30eaa957914f51e0: You don’t know my rank, and I don’t answer to your command. Let’s get back to business, shall we?
en.68c803490805e50ab54fec21: What? I could crush you to bits if I wanted! But I’ll let it slide this time, since you’re a tourist here. Besides, the task is very urgent, no time to waste.
en.68c803e647a7672455dde23e: A fucker like you will probably be interested in getting access to the Reserve military base. But now I’ll add one more condition.
en.68c80403838ea8b014f2569c: The base is crawling with looters trying to grab government property. I don’t need another idiot there like them. Promise me that if you go on this mission, you’ll squash those bastards like cockroaches.
en.68c8040f590941d48b87f85f: I wasn’t planning to cooperate with them anyway. I’ll do what I can.
en.68c8042c0afe9f8aec1433ae: Good, make sure you keep it…
en.68c8044e69f5e5803d34f7f3: The reward’s settled. What do you want in return for this route?
en.68c80467487b9ae85e666954: Suppose I take this task. You offering a reward?
en.68c8047290c359b960f2b47b: You’re pretty businesslike for a tourist! But in Tarkov, that’s not a bad thing. I can show you a place only a few people know about.
en.68c8049f2dc34216e15f289f: A former Reserve military base. I wouldn’t normally let you in, but it’s crawling with those damn looters… maybe you can tidy the place up a bit.
en.68c804ab98ce3a0e1a00624d: The place is probably rich with valuable intel and equipment. Couldn’t you just take the whole base yourself?
en.68c804b59c7e50d9a926d467: Have you ever seen a fucking military base? To hold a place that big, I’d need at least three times more people than I have now, and that’s only for perimeter guard! Plus the area itself isn’t that pleasant. Only Glukhar managed to settle in. And still, even he doesn’t control the whole base.
en.68c804cd7dc073231a7f6597: Crazy bastard. Used to serve in the navy. He’s gathered some skilled vets, with good gear and guns. So be careful around them.
en.68c804e3f8e6de2988221e1a: Nope. During the Contract Wars, he forgot all about his oath. And even before that, he stirred some trouble with the local administration… but that’s just rumors.
en.68c804ece1d8aee99334e225: Okay then. What do you want from me in exchange for the route?
en.68c8051ef30cb54089187e43: Recently, my convoy was hit. From the gear, it’s clear they weren’t just random Scavs. They couldn’t have gone far, so we still have a chance to catch them.
en.68c8053ae66d6b1e4564657f: There’s a health resort on Shoreline, the “Azure Coast”. Used to be a nice spot… So anyway, there’s a road north of it, that’s where the convoy was heading. They got hit somewhere around there.
en.68c80544a066d95d22fa4623: So, should I scout the area?
en.68c8054f354c7cc4bfab5874: Fuck the scouting! I need to punish those idiots, not hold a court session. If I wait, every pillager in the area will show up. Everyone wants a piece of my gear.
en.68c80559bcd768f1c2c1d426: How do I identify the targets?
en.68c809606cf6713f1daca76d: No need to identify. It’s clear they were PMCs, though I’m not sure which side they were on – you’ll know for sure when you get the dogtags from their bodies. Go bring me those dogtags, show me that you mean business.
en.68c8096ad858fe87f240958f: Understood. I’ll come back once it’s done.
en.68c80985e81a257cbec841e6: All done. Here are your dogtags. (Hand over the PMC dogtags)
en.68c8099289aa273b9f150b6b: Good, give them here… I’ve heard you mercs lost contact with command. Looks like some of you decided to change your “work priorities” straight away.
en.68c809ae122775a0aea90eaf: Well, that makes sense. How else do you survive after you’ve been left for dead with no support?
en.68c809c35b30da6dee6b62f1: I’m not responsible for them. PMCs are made up of different people with different goals.
en.68c809cd08bafb6c6739ea20: They could start doing what you’re doing, at least! Secure connections, make a safe hideout. If you know how to communicate and keep your word, you can do well even in Tarkov.
en.68c809df3161ec714979be3a: You think I don’t know that? You need serious discipline and a clear head in war times. Like you, for example: you build connections, get settled in the city. Don’t mess around and earn a reputation — that’ll make you go far.
en.68c809f1fcd78c08d50bd9f4: Speaking of. How do I reach that military base?
en.68c80a1a13e657277a677f3b: My guys will show you the route. After that, you’re on your own. Reserve is a dangerous, restless place.

fr.68c802e84628689dc645076e: Ouais, j’avais remarqué. Vous m’avez fait venir. Vous avez un boulot pour moi ?
fr.68c802f27696a4988e1a27bd: Bien sûr ! Tu as impressionné le Mécano avec tes compétences, donc je me dis que tu as la tête sur les épaules et que tu n’es pas complètement inutile. Je suis prêt à te confier une mission de combat.
fr.68c8031ba457ce8b40da3222: Quoi, la gratitude de la Mère Patrie ne te suffit plus ?
fr.68c803271a30e101ab964b28: J’ai des doutes sur le fait que votre travail ait quoi que ce soit à voir avec la Mère Patrie dont vous parlez.
fr.68c80333f34a826cf82da5ef: Comment oses-tu parler ainsi à vos supérieurs, bleusaille ?!
fr.68c8033d30eaa957914f51e0: Vous ne connaissez pas mon grade, et je ne réponds pas à vos ordres. Revenons aux affaires, d’accord ?
fr.68c803490805e50ab54fec21: Quoi ? Je pourrais t’écraser si je le voulais ! Mais je vais laisser passer cette fois, puisque tu es un touriste ici. Et puis la mission est très urgente, pas de temps à perdre.
fr.68c803e647a7672455dde23e: Un type comme toi sera sûrement intéressé par l’accès à la base militaire. Mais je vais ajouter une condition.
fr.68c80403838ea8b014f2569c: La base grouille de pillards qui tentent de mettre la main sur des biens gouvernementaux. Je n’ai pas besoin d’un idiot de plus comme eux là-bas. Promettez-moi que si vous acceptez cette mission, vous écraserez ces bâtards comme des cafards.
fr.68c8040f590941d48b87f85f: Je n’avais pas l’intention de coopérer avec eux de toute façon. Je ferai ce que je peux.
fr.68c8044e69f5e5803d34f7f3: La récompense est définie. Qu’est-ce que vous voulez en échange de cet itinéraire ?
fr.68c80467487b9ae85e666954: Supposons que j’accepte cette tâche. Vous proposez une récompense ?
fr.68c8047290c359b960f2b47b: Tu es sacrément porté sur les affaires pour un touriste ! Mais à Tarkov, ce n’est pas un défaut. Je peux te montrer un endroit que très peu de gens connaissent.
fr.68c8049f2dc34216e15f289f: Une ancienne base militaire. Normalement, je ne t’y laisserais pas entrer, mais elle est infestée de ces foutus pillards… peut-être que tu pourrais faire un peu de ménage.
fr.68c804ab98ce3a0e1a00624d: L’endroit doit regorger de renseignements et d’équipements de valeur. Pourquoi ne pas prendre la base entière vous-même ?
fr.68c804b59c7e50d9a926d467: T’as déjà vu une putain de base militaire ? Pour tenir un endroit aussi vaste, il me faudrait au moins trois fois plus de monde que ce que j’ai actuellement, et encore, juste pour sécuriser le périmètre ! En plus, la zone en elle-même n’est pas vraiment accueillante. Il n’y a que Glukhar qui a réussi à s’y installer. Et même lui, il ne contrôle pas toute la base.
fr.68c804cd7dc073231a7f6597: Un sacré taré. Il a servi dans la marine. Il a rassemblé des vétérans compétents, bien équipés et lourdement armés. Alors fais gaffe quand tu t’approches d’eux.
fr.68c804d894c98d37911b277f: Il ne travaille pas avec vous ?
fr.68c804e3f8e6de2988221e1a: Non. Pendant les Contract Wars, il a complètement oublié son serment. Et même avant ça, il aurait déjà causé pas mal de problèmes à l’administration locale… mais ça reste des rumeurs.
fr.68c804ece1d8aee99334e225: D’accord. Alors dites-moi ce que vous voulez  de moi en échange de l’itinéraire.
fr.68c8051ef30cb54089187e43: Récemment, mon convoi s’est fait attaquer. À en juger par leur équipement, ce n’étaient clairement pas de simples scavs. Ils n’ont pas pu aller bien loin, on a donc encore une chance de les rattraper.
fr.68c8053ae66d6b1e4564657f: Il y a une station thermale sur le littoral, la « Côte d’Azur ». C’était un coin sympa, à l’époque… Bref. Il y a une route au nord de la station, c’est par là que le convoi se dirigeait. Ils se sont fait attaquer quelque part dans ce secteur.
fr.68c80544a066d95d22fa4623: Du coup, je dois faire le repérage de la zone ?
fr.68c8054f354c7cc4bfab5874: Au diable le repérage ! J’ai besoin de punir ces abrutis, pas d’organiser un procès. Si j’attends, tous les pillards du coin vont rappliquer. Tout le monde veut mettre la main sur mon matos.
fr.68c809606cf6713f1daca76d: Pas besoin de les identifier. C’est évident que c’étaient des opérateurs, même si je ne sais pas encore de quel camp ils étaient. Tu le sauras quand tu récupéreras leurs plaques d’identification sur les corps. Va me rapporter ces dogtags et montre-moi que tu es sérieux.
fr.68c8096ad858fe87f240958f: Compris, je reviendrais quand ça sera fait.
fr.68c80985e81a257cbec841e6: C'est fait, voilà vos dogtags. (Donner les dogtags)
fr.68c8099289aa273b9f150b6b: Bien, donne-les-moi… J’ai entendu dire que vous, les mercenaires, avez perdu le contact avec le commandement. On dirait que certains d’entre vous ont décidé de changer tout de suite leurs « priorités professionnelles ».
fr.68c809ae122775a0aea90eaf: Eh bien, ça se comprend. Comment voulez-vous survivre autrement, quand on vous a laissés pour morts sans aucun soutien ?
fr.68c809c35b30da6dee6b62f1: Je ne suis pas responsable d’eux. Les opérateurs sont composés de personnes différentes, avec des objectifs différents.
fr.68c809cd08bafb6c6739ea20: Ils pourraient au moins commencer à faire ce que tu fais ! Sécuriser des contacts, se créer une planque sûre. Si tu sais communiquer et tenir parole, tu peux t’en sortir même à Tarkov.
fr.68c809df3161ec714979be3a: Tu crois que je ne le sais pas ? En temps de guerre, il faut une discipline de fer et la tête froide. Regarde-toi, par exemple : tu construis des relations, tu t’installes en ville. Ne fais pas n’importe quoi et forge-toi une réputation, c’est comme ça que tu iras loin.
fr.68c809f1fcd78c08d50bd9f4: En parlant de ça, comment est-ce que je me rends à la base militaire ?
fr.68c80a1a13e657277a677f3b: Mes gars vont te montrer le chemin. Après ça, tu seras livré à toi-même. La base est un endroit dangereux, instable.

ge.68c802e84628689dc645076e: Yeah, noticed that already. You called me here. Got a job for me?
ge.68c802f27696a4988e1a27bd: Of course! You impressed Mechanic with your skills, so I figure your head’s in the right place and you aren’t completely useless. So I’m ready to trust you with a combat mission.
ge.68c80306e777cceaa1bda13d: What do I get in return?
ge.68c8031ba457ce8b40da3222: What, gratitude from the Motherland isn’t enough for you now?
ge.68c803271a30e101ab964b28: I doubt your work has anything to do with the Motherland you're singing about.
ge.68c80333f34a826cf82da5ef: How dare you talk to your seniors like that, rookie?!
ge.68c8033d30eaa957914f51e0: You don’t know my rank, and I don’t answer to your command. Let’s get back to business, shall we?
ge.68c803490805e50ab54fec21: What? I could crush you to bits if I wanted! But I’ll let it slide this time, since you’re a tourist here. Besides, the task is very urgent, no time to waste.
ge.68c803e647a7672455dde23e: A fucker like you will probably be interested in getting access to the Reserve military base. But now I’ll add one more condition.
ge.68c80403838ea8b014f2569c: The base is crawling with looters trying to grab government property. I don’t need another idiot there like them. Promise me that if you go on this mission, you’ll squash those bastards like cockroaches.
ge.68c8040f590941d48b87f85f: I wasn’t planning to cooperate with them anyway. I’ll do what I can.
ge.68c8042c0afe9f8aec1433ae: Good, make sure you keep it…
ge.68c8044e69f5e5803d34f7f3: The reward’s settled. What do you want in return for this route?
ge.68c80467487b9ae85e666954: Suppose I take this task. You offering a reward?
ge.68c8047290c359b960f2b47b: You’re pretty businesslike for a tourist! But in Tarkov, that’s not a bad thing. I can show you a place only a few people know about.
ge.68c8049f2dc34216e15f289f: A former Reserve military base. I wouldn’t normally let you in, but it’s crawling with those damn looters… maybe you can tidy the place up a bit.
ge.68c804ab98ce3a0e1a00624d: The place is probably rich with valuable intel and equipment. Couldn’t you just take the whole base yourself?
ge.68c804b59c7e50d9a926d467: Have you ever seen a fucking military base? To hold a place that big, I’d need at least three times more people than I have now, and that’s only for perimeter guard! Plus the area itself isn’t that pleasant. Only Glukhar managed to settle in. And still, even he doesn’t control the whole base.
ge.68c804cd7dc073231a7f6597: Crazy bastard. Used to serve in the navy. He’s gathered some skilled vets, with good gear and guns. So be careful around them.
ge.68c804e3f8e6de2988221e1a: Nope. During the Contract Wars, he forgot all about his oath. And even before that, he stirred some trouble with the local administration… but that’s just rumors.
ge.68c804ece1d8aee99334e225: Okay then. What do you want from me in exchange for the route?
ge.68c8051ef30cb54089187e43: Recently, my convoy was hit. From the gear, it’s clear they weren’t just random Scavs. They couldn’t have gone far, so we still have a chance to catch them.
ge.68c8053ae66d6b1e4564657f: There’s a health resort on Shoreline, the “Azure Coast”. Used to be a nice spot… So anyway, there’s a road north of it, that’s where the convoy was heading. They got hit somewhere around there.
ge.68c80544a066d95d22fa4623: So, should I scout the area?
ge.68c8054f354c7cc4bfab5874: Fuck the scouting! I need to punish those idiots, not hold a court session. If I wait, every pillager in the area will show up. Everyone wants a piece of my gear.
ge.68c80559bcd768f1c2c1d426: How do I identify the targets?
ge.68c809606cf6713f1daca76d: No need to identify. It’s clear they were PMCs, though I’m not sure which side they were on – you’ll know for sure when you get the dogtags from their bodies. Go bring me those dogtags, show me that you mean business.
ge.68c8096ad858fe87f240958f: Understood. I’ll come back once it’s done.
ge.68c80985e81a257cbec841e6: All done. Here are your dogtags. (Hand over the PMC dogtags)
ge.68c8099289aa273b9f150b6b: Good, give them here… I’ve heard you mercs lost contact with command. Looks like some of you decided to change your “work priorities” straight away.
ge.68c809ae122775a0aea90eaf: Well, that makes sense. How else do you survive after you’ve been left for dead with no support?
ge.68c809c35b30da6dee6b62f1: I’m not responsible for them. PMCs are made up of different people with different goals.
ge.68c809cd08bafb6c6739ea20: They could start doing what you’re doing, at least! Secure connections, make a safe hideout. If you know how to communicate and keep your word, you can do well even in Tarkov.
ge.68c809df3161ec714979be3a: You think I don’t know that? You need serious discipline and a clear head in war times. Like you, for example: you build connections, get settled in the city. Don’t mess around and earn a reputation — that’ll make you go far.
ge.68c809f1fcd78c08d50bd9f4: Speaking of. How do I reach that military base?
ge.68c80a1a13e657277a677f3b: My guys will show you the route. After that, you’re on your own. Reserve is a dangerous, restless place.
